dedupe_keys.name: agencia portuguesa do ambiente wastewater datasets

description: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Coverage: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. The listing groups 35 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PGRH Algarve - RH8 - Pontos de rejeição de águas residuais domésticas ; Pontos de descarga das ETARs da Diretiva das Águas Residuais Urbanas; Pontos de descarga das ETARs da Diretiva das Águas Residuais Urbanas: ; RH4 - Caracterização Região Hidrográfica – Sistemas de Drenagem e Trat. Formats seen: PDF, ZIP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
